harness_findings.what: TypeError: 'in <string>' requires string as left operand, not NoneType
harness_findings.why: Rename operators carry name=None (they use from_name/to_name); downstream display must not pass None into string membership tests.
harness_findings.fix: Use op.name or f"{op.from_name} -> {op.to_name}" for rename ops (implemented in start.py).
harness_findings.evidence: verify.sh Layer 3 cli-smoke OK (2026-07-06); start.py lines 242, 305, 408 guard rename display

harness_findings.why: It creates a full copy of the NetworkX directed graph object, wasting CPU cycles and memory on each impact query.
harness_findings.fix: Use '.reverse(copy=False)' to return a read-only view of the reversed graph without copying memory.
harness_findings.evidence: get_downstream_impact() uses g.reverse(copy=False) in Phase 1.1 rigor refactor

harness_findings.what: O(D×A) pairwise similarity comparisons in rename detection.
harness_findings.why: Pairwise SequenceMatcher comparison between deleted symbols and added symbols results in quadratic complexity.
harness_findings.fix: Use pre-computed body fingerprints + threshold-based hashing to group candidates first, then compare only high-probability pairs.
harness_findings.evidence: fingerprint_bucket wired in _match_symbol_renames; stub/identifier gates; test_formatter_invariant_rename_detection + false-positive tests

harness_findings.what: O(F²) nested iteration during static call resolution.
harness_findings.why: Looping over defined functions to resolve imports and local calls without index queries leads to quadratic complexity.
harness_findings.fix: Index function definitions by name and file to allow O(1) lookups during resolution.
harness_findings.evidence: _symbol_index + find_node_by_name() reduce candidate scans; import-edge iteration remains O(F×imports)

harness_findings.what: O(N) scan to find stale nodes of a modified file.
harness_findings.why: Scanning all graph nodes to filter by the 'file' attribute is a linear operation.
harness_findings.fix: Maintain a reverse mapping/index of File -> Set[NodeID] to query and remove stale nodes in O(K) where K is the number of symbols in the file.

harness_findings.what: AST parser recomputes from scratch on every parse invocation.
harness_findings.why: Missing memoization or file hash checks causes the parser to parse files repeatedly even if unchanged.
harness_findings.fix: Implement file content hashing (MD5/SHA256) and cache parse results in memory or disk.

harness_findings.what: ast_parser returns a flat list of CodeSymbols, requiring O(N) lookup.
harness_findings.why: Downstream consumers must scan the list linearly to find symbols by name or type.
harness_findings.fix: Expose an indexed dictionary interface (e.g. dict[str, CodeSymbol]) alongside the flat list.

harness_findings.discovered_by: live gdss status on non-ASCII sources
harness_findings.what: Tree-sitter byte offsets used as Python str indices corrupted symbol names.
harness_findings.why: Non-ASCII prefixes shift byte vs char indices; rename endpoints became garbage.

harness_findings.what: Symbol maps keyed only by name collided across classes.
harness_findings.why: Methods like run/__init__ in different classes overwrote each other.

harness_findings.what: fingerprint_bucket helper unused; stub pairs false-positive renames.
harness_findings.fix: Wire buckets + reject near-empty stubs and non-identifiers.

harness_findings.what: status labeled remote event topic as DRIFT DETECTED.
harness_findings.why: remote_aware is event-bus recency, not ahead/behind divergence.
harness_findings.fix: Show Git ahead/behind or N/A; never map remote_aware to DRIFT.
harness_findings.evidence: cli_smoke asserts no DRIFT DETECTED; get_remote_sync_status

harness_findings.what: --ref ignored; config ref printed success without persistence.
harness_findings.why: do_status discarded arg; config did not write hierarchy DB.
